name: splitpane
need: Show two or three panes side by side or stacked, resized by dragging or the keyboard, remembered, collapsible

--ds-splitpane-size.description: split pane: the start size of a pane, any length or a percentage of the split pane (on the pane; registered, does not inherit; DS.splitpane writes it as the pane moves)

--ds-splitpane-min.description: split pane: the smallest size of a pane (on the pane; registered, does not inherit)

--ds-splitpane-max.description: split pane: the largest size of a pane (on the pane; registered, does not inherit)

--ds-splitpane-height.description: split pane: its height (a length where the parent grows with its content)

--ds-splitpane-grip.description: split pane: the grip on the divider

--ds-splitpane-hit.description: split pane: the width of the divider's hit area, over both panes' edges (`.ds-touch`: at least half the touch target)

--ds-splitpane-padding.description: `.ds-splitpane__body`: the padding, 2px less per density step
